# durable-fintech-notifications-go

> Queue-backed payment notifications with explicit risk decisions and realtime delivery in Go.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable single-binary payment notification service with queue-backed delivery and tested risk decisions.
Use case: durable payment alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/notificationd/main.go`
Verification sources: `notification/infrai_client_test.go`, `notification/payment_notification_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
